context: An overloaded agent guide duplicated as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. A good rewrite leaves one authored guide that CLAUDE.md imports or symlinks, keeps the exact lifecycle commands and repository hazards, maps kinds of change to their checks, links deeper docs by the question they answer, and drops the directory tour, API copy, generated table, and process checkpoints that have no task-specific reason.

checklist.name: Process checkpoints dropped
checklist.description: AGENTS.md has no mandatory read-all-docs list, no run-tests-after-every-edit reminder, no stop-after-N-commits review checkpoint, and no attempt cap.

checklist.name: One authored source
checklist.description: CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md or contains only an `@AGENTS.md` import (optionally with a one-line note). A CLAUDE.md that carries its own copy of the guide, synced or not, earns nothing.

checklist.name: Hazards kept
checklist.description: AGENTS.md keeps: migrations only via `npx knex migrate:make`, never editing existing ones; never logging STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; the logger and AppError rules; no force push to main.

checklist.name: No dumps, task-shaped links
checklist.description: AGENTS.md has no directory tree, endpoint bodies, or auto-generated file table, and each link to docs/architecture.md, docs/api.md, or docs/deployment.md says when to open it.

checklist.name: Change-to-check map
checklist.description: AGENTS.md says which check proves which kind of change, for example `npm test` and `npm run lint` for code, plus `npm run test:integration` (with a database) for data or migration changes.

checklist.name: Exact commands
checklist.description: AGENTS.md has `npm run dev` and `scripts/setup.sh`, and no reference to scripts/bootstrap.sh.
